goals.title: Build factory core
goals.description: Build the neutral SVFactory core that can load, validate, compile, and materialize KBX agents from DNA.
goals.success_criteria: SVFactory can generate a KBX agent package skeleton from a valid DNA spec.

goals.title: Ship the DNA loader, validator, and compiler path
goals.description: Make DNA ingestion deterministic from contract loading through compiled manifest generation.
goals.success_criteria: A valid DNA package can be loaded, validated, and compiled without manual intervention.

goals.title: KR1.1.1 — Load all four DNA contracts
goals.description: Support dna.json, ontology.json, governance.json, and release.json loading from one spec root.
goals.success_criteria: One command resolves all four contract files from a spec root with zero missing references.

goals.title: KR1.1.2 — Compile a deterministic DNA manifest
goals.description: Produce a compiled manifest that downstream materialization can consume.
goals.success_criteria: The compiler emits one deterministic manifest per valid DNA spec.

goals.title: Materialize a KBX package skeleton
goals.description: Turn the compiled manifest into a KBX-shaped output plan and package skeleton.
goals.success_criteria: SVFactory produces a valid KBX package skeleton from the compiled manifest.

goals.title: KR1.2.1 — Generate a KBX output plan
goals.description: Map compiled DNA into package directories, assets, bindings, and templates.
goals.success_criteria: The materializer outputs one complete filesystem plan for a KBX package.

goals.title: KR1.2.2 — Bootstrap a runnable KBX package shell
goals.description: Emit the first runnable package scaffold from SVFactory.
goals.success_criteria: The generated package installs and exposes its initial CLI/UI shell.

goals.title: Define KBX DNA schema v0.1
goals.description: Standardize how domain DNA is described so KBX agents can be generated repeatably.
goals.success_criteria: A domain DNA can be authored and validated using a stable v0.1 schema contract.

goals.title: KR2.1 — Lock the four contract files
goals.description: Use dna.json, ontology.json, governance.json, and release.json as the canonical v0.1 contract set.
goals.success_criteria: Every KBX DNA package declares the same four canonical files.

goals.title: KR2.2 — Roundtrip one reference DNA through validation
goals.description: Use dna/kbx as the first reference DNA package for schema proof.
goals.success_criteria: The reference DNA validates with zero contract errors.

goals.title: Publish first KBX agent npm package
goals.description: Ship the first user-installable KBX agent package generated by SVFactory.
goals.success_criteria: An end user can install and run the first generated KBX agent package.

goals.title: KR3.1 — Make the generated package installable
goals.description: Ensure the generated KBX package can be installed from an npm tarball.
goals.success_criteria: npm install succeeds for the generated agent package.

goals.title: KR3.2 — Complete the first publish path
goals.description: Prove the package can move from generated artifact to published package.
goals.success_criteria: One generated agent package reaches a publish-ready release candidate state.

goals.title: Build quality gate
goals.description: Make sure a KBX package does not only build, but also validates and tests successfully.
goals.success_criteria: Every generated package passes a deterministic quality gate before release.

goals.title: KR4.1 — Enforce schema and compile gates
goals.description: Stop invalid DNA packages before materialization or release.
goals.success_criteria: Invalid DNA cannot pass contract validation or compile gates.

goals.title: KR4.2 — Run generated package smoke tests
goals.description: Add smoke tests proving the generated package can start and expose its expected shell.
goals.success_criteria: Every release candidate package passes smoke tests before publish.

goals.title: Build maintainability flow
goals.description: Design the generated package and the factory itself so they can be fixed, upgraded, versioned, and released sustainably.
goals.success_criteria: SVFactory and generated KBX packages have deterministic upgrade and maintenance paths.

goals.title: KR5.1 — Define versioning and upgrade contracts
goals.description: Version both DNA and generated package outputs with clear compatibility rules.
goals.success_criteria: A maintainer can tell what version changed and how to upgrade it.

goals.title: KR5.2 — Define bugfix and release maintenance flow
goals.description: Make bugfix, patch, and release work part of the canonical factory process.
goals.success_criteria: Generated KBX packages can be patched and released without manual ad hoc steps.

goals.title: Enable autonomous repository research for KBX agents
goals.description: KBAgent can autonomously scan repository content (dependencies, structure, code patterns, docs) and persist findings as a knowledge graph to GraphDB for downstream query and visualization.
goals.success_criteria: One end-to-end flow: `kbx research` on a target repo produces a GraphDB-backed knowledge graph that can be served via `kbx serve`.

goals.title: KR6.1 — Auto-scan reference repo and persist to GraphDB
goals.description: Validate the research pipeline by running `kbx research` on a known reference repo (e.g., a KBX agent repo) and confirming all findings are stored in GraphDB with cited evidence sources.
goals.success_criteria: Pipeline runs without error, GraphDB contains nodes for dependencies, folder structure, code patterns, docs, and configuration. Each node includes confidence score and evidence source.

goals.title: Define the natural‑rules foundation for SVFactory
goals.description: Establish the file architecture and schema for domain‑specific natural rules, enabling rule‑based agent generation alongside DNA contracts.
goals.success_criteria: Natural rules file architecture is documented, validated, and integrated into the SVFactory DNA pipeline.

goals.title: KR7.1 — Lock the natural‑rules file architecture v0.1
goals.description: Define the canonical file structure, naming conventions, and integration points for natural rules within SVFactory.
goals.success_criteria: One reference natural‑rules package passes structural validation and is consumable by downstream compilation.

goals.title: Runtime test harness for generated KBX agents
goals.description: Ensure that generated KBX agents can be tested at the dispatch runtime level, validating agent lifecycle and integration with the SVFactory pipeline.
goals.success_criteria: A test harness exists and passes smoke tests for at least one generated agent type.

goals.title: KR8.1 — Dispatch runtime test harness operational
goals.description: A test harness that validates the runtime dispatch of generated KBX agents, including agent startup, execution, and shutdown.
goals.success_criteria: Test harness runs and validates at least one full agent lifecycle with no critical failures.
goals.key_result_target: Passing smoke test on a reference agent

goals.title: Enable queryable KBAgent state without breaking backward compatibility
goals.description: Create a minimal structured store layer that makes KBAgent state (rules, documents, intent status) queryable via simple queries, while keeping all existing Markdown/JSON file outputs unchanged.
goals.success_criteria: Spike produces an adapter and query model that passes at least 3 test queries (e.g., latest failed rules by intent, documents stale by verification window, active intents by release).

goals.title: KR9.1 — Structured store spike with backward compatibility verified
goals.description: Design and implement a storage adapter and query model that mirrors current JSON/Markdown outputs, then validate with 3 representative queries.
goals.success_criteria: All 3 test queries return correct results; existing file outputs remain unchanged
goals.key_result_target: 3 queries passed with zero regression in file outputs

goals.title: Ensure CLI and concept naming consistency
goals.description: Maintain clear, non‑conflicting naming across the KBX ecosystem. The CLI binary and npm package must not collide with existing packages (e.g., kb), and the internal concept name (SV Factory) must be distinguishable from the executive layer (KB Agent) to avoid confusion in documentation and governance.
goals.success_criteria: All user‑facing surfaces (binary, npm package, template files, prompts, source paths) use the new names. Internal docs use the clarified concept name. No deprecated aliases remain. Downstream migration treated as separate work.

goals.title: KR10.1 — Complete the CLI and concept rename (kb→kbx, SV Factory→SV Factory)
goals.description: Two parallel renames: (1) CLI binary `kb` → `kbx` and npm package `@williamduong/kb` → `@williamduong/kbx` across all user‑facing surfaces. (2) Internal concept rename 'SV Factory' → 'SV Factory' (sfact) in governance and self‑host docs. Hard cut – no deprecated aliases. Downstream migration is a separate intent.
goals.success_criteria: v2.4.0 shipped with all rename changes. No regressions in CI. Package published under new name. Internal docs updated.
goals.key_result_metric: Intents and packages using new names
goals.key_result_target: v2.4.0 release shipped with zero backward‑compatibility shims

goals.title: Define and implement domain lifecycle separation for KBX DNA packages
goals.description: Establish clear lifecycle stages (e.g., draft, active, deprecated, retired) for domain-specific DNA packages managed by SVFactory, ensuring each domain can evolve independently without affecting others.
goals.success_criteria: Lifecycle stages documented, implemented in SVFactory's schema and CLI, and validated with at least one reference domain package.

goals.title: KR11.1 — Domain lifecycle stages documented and implemented in SVFactory
goals.description: Define lifecycle stages (draft, active, deprecated, retired) for KBX DNA packages, add lifecycle field to dna.json contract, and implement hooks in the factory for stage transitions.
goals.success_criteria: Lifecycle stages published in governance guide, dna.json schema v0.2 includes lifecycle field, and at least one domain package transitions through all stages via SVFactory CLI.
goals.key_result_target: Lifecycle field in dna.json; one package transitions draft → active

goals.title: Enable project-level customization of intent governance defaults
goals.description: Make KBX agent templates configurable per project so teams can override opinionated defaults (stale threshold, required fields, ID format, branch prefix, wave field, release reference format) without forking the template, while still receiving upgrade patches.
goals.success_criteria: Config layer is documented, implemented, and ships as part of V2.5 with at least one migration path for existing projects.

goals.title: KR12.1 — Config layer implemented for all six default categories
goals.description: Deliver a config file (or equivalent) that allows overriding stale threshold, required fields, ID format, branch prefix, wave field, and release reference format. Must include an override log for auditability.
goals.success_criteria: All six defaults overridable; config file schema published; upgrade path verified for at least one existing project.

goals.title: Enable operational visibility and data persistence for KBX agents
goals.description: Provide a production-grade database layer for KBX agent data and a web UI to manage intents, chaos scores, rule results, and audit events without requiring CLI commands for routine inspection.
goals.success_criteria: DB layer with SQLite adapter is feature-flagged and production-ready; Intent Web UI serves at least three core management views (list, detail, audit).

goals.title: KR13.1 — DB layer and Intent Web UI shipped as a single bundled release
goals.description: SQLite adapter with migrations and seed logic, plus a local web server (`kbx serve`) providing intent management UI; governance UI reads from production DB.
goals.success_criteria: Both components shipped together as release v2.9; `kbx init` creates empty .kb workspace; `kbx serve` runs without CLI-only inspection.
goals.key_result_metric: Number of functional UI views shipped

goals.title: Establish generative loop for KBX agent generation
goals.description: Define and implement the feedback loop that allows SVFactory to iteratively generate and improve KBX agents from DNA specifications.
goals.success_criteria: Generative loop contract is defined, implemented, and validated with at least one end-to-end cycle.

goals.title: KR14.1 — Define and validate the generative loop contract
goals.description: Create the contract (API, data flow, triggers) that governs how the generative loop operates between DNA compilation and agent materialization.
goals.success_criteria: Contract is documented, reviewed, and passes a simulated generative cycle.

goals.title: Resolve KBX agent roadmap P0 alignment gaps
goals.description: Ensure every P0-priority intent in the KBX agent roadmap is clearly aligned to a measurable key result and traceable to the north star. This includes closing the 11 unmapped intents and validating that their goals fit the overall SVFactory mission.
goals.success_criteria: All P0 intents have a linked key result with a defined metric and target; zero intents in 'missing-key-result' validation state for P0.

goals.title: KR15.1 — All P0 intents mapped to key results and validated against north star
goals.description: For each P0 intent currently without a key result, either create a new KR or bind to an existing one. Validate that the linked KR directly advances the north star (Build SVFactory as the factory that generates KBX agents from DNA).
goals.success_criteria: 100% of P0 intents have a linked KR; no P0 intent remains in 'missing-key-result' state.
goals.key_result_metric: Percentage of P0 intents with a linked key result

goals.title: Establish ontology lifecycle foundation for KBX agents
goals.description: Deliver the ontology model as a living schema module with deterministic steps from natural language to ontology schema, enabling lifecycle management for KBX agents.
goals.success_criteria: All three steps (NL capture, glossary, schema) are functional and documented; the ontology module passes close-condition sweep.

goals.title: KR16.1 — Ontology foundation v2.6 shipped
goals.description: Natural-language capture, governed glossary, and ontology schema implemented per intent v2-6-kb-ontology-foundation.
goals.success_criteria: Intent closed with 6/6 close-condition sweep passed; template/docs aligned.

goals.title: Establish architectural governance for CLI command layer ownership (SV Factory vs KBAgent)
goals.description: Define and ratify which CLI commands belong to SV Factory (Legislative, deterministic) vs KBAgent (Executive, soft-first) per the 5 architectural axioms. This ensures every future command carries an explicit layer assignment before implementation.
goals.success_criteria: All v2.5 commands have a documented layer assignment; soft-first governance policy is textually locked as KBAgent-only contract; no ambiguity remains for the monorepo split.

goals.title: KR17.1 — Layer classification table approved and soft-first governance policy documented as KBAgent-only contract
goals.description: Produce a single authoritative table mapping each v2.5 CLI command to its layer (SV Factory or KBAgent) with rationale per axiom. Document the soft-first governance policy explicitly as applying only to KBAgent commands. Both artifacts reviewed and approved by owner.
goals.success_criteria: Table published in notes/; policy text committed; zero commands with ambiguous layer; owner sign-off.
goals.key_result_metric: Number of commands with explicit layer assignment
goals.key_result_target: All v2.5 commands (>=4) assigned; soft-first policy text merged.
